props.name: value
props.description: Controlled path of values, first column first.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen path and the options along it.

props.name: loadChildren
props.description: Fetches the children of an option that has none yet. Resolve an empty array for a leaf.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger and the panel.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the trigger while nothing is chosen.

props.name: separator
props.description: Placed between the labels of the path on the trigger.

props.name: allowParentSelection
props.description: Let a choice stop part-way down — “all of California” — rather than only at a leaf.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control as failing validation.

props.name: id
props.description: Goes on the trigger, so a Field label points at it.
